banner.phase0: The foundation is live — tools are rolling out phase by phase.

hero.subtitle: Most tools run right in your browser — no uploads, no waiting.

steps.title: How it works
steps.subtitle: Three steps, three clicks — the same simple flow for every tool.
steps.s1desc: Pick files from your device, or simply drop them in.
steps.s2desc: Set your options with a live preview before running.
steps.s3desc: Save, share, or chain straight into the next tool.

categories.title: Explore the toolbox
categories.subtitle: {count} tools across {categories} categories — with an honest mode badge on every tool.
categories.phaseNote: Roadmap order: device-only tools first, server tools last.

why.title: Why DocoPDF?
why.subtitle: Honest, private, and built mobile-first for India.
why.privateDesc: Device-only tools never send your files anywhere. What's yours stays yours.
why.fastDesc: No upload wait — processing happens on your own device, even offline.
why.freeDesc: No signup, no watermarks, no hidden limits on device tools. Ever.

modes.title: Two honest modes
modes.subtitle: Every tool tells you exactly where your file goes — nothing hidden.
modes.deviceDesc: The whole job runs in your browser using Web Workers. Your file never touches the network.
modes.devicePoint1: Merge, split, compress, sign, edit and much more
modes.devicePoint2: Works offline once installed as an app
modes.devicePoint3: Zero upload time — great for batches
modes.serverDesc: Only for jobs a browser can't do well (like Office ↔ PDF). Files are deleted immediately after processing — never stored.
modes.serverPoint1: Deleted right after the job (15-minute fail-safe)
modes.serverPoint2: No file names or contents in any log
modes.serverPoint3: Clear limits: 10 free server tasks per day

tools.title: All tools
tools.subtitle: {count} tools across the toolbox — favorites and recent tools stay on this device.
tools.noResultsDesc: Try a different word, or tell us what you need — we build the most-requested tools first.
tools.searchHint: Search as you type — try “merge”, “jodein” or “password”.

request.title: Request a tool
request.description: Tell us what's missing. Requests are saved on this device until tool-request voting goes live.
request.descPlaceholder: A short description of what you need…

palette.title: Search tools
palette.description: Search the DocoPDF toolbox by name, tag or Hindi keyword.

consent.title: Your choice, your data
consent.body: DocoPDF works without analytics. Allow anonymous usage counts to help us improve? No file names, no file contents — ever.
consent.analyticsDesc: Aggregate tool usage counts only. Always off for file contents.
consent.essentialNote: Essential cookies (language, theme, favorites) are always on and stay on your device.

pro.title: Pro is coming
pro.body: Paid features arrive in a later phase. Device-only tools will always stay free — that's a promise.

footer.trust: Most tools run inside your browser. Your files stay on your device.
footer.phaseNote: DocoPDF is being built in phases — the design system is live, tools are next.

dropzone.limits: PDF up to {size} · up to {count} files
dropzone.errTooManyDesc: This tool accepts up to {count} files at once.
dropzone.errTooLargeDesc: The limit is {size} per file on this device.
dropzone.errNotPdfDesc: We checked the file's content — it isn't a valid PDF.
dropzone.warnLowSpaceDesc: Your browser storage is nearly full. Consider freeing some space.

tool.helpPrivacy: Everything happens on this device. The file is never uploaded, and working copies are deleted as soon as the tool finishes.
tool.how1: Select one or more PDF files — they stay on your device.
tool.how2: Set your options and check the preview before running.
tool.how3: Download the result, share it, or chain it into another tool.
tool.keepTabOpen: Tip: keep this tab open. You can keep using the site in another tab.
tool.errorGeneric: The tool hit an unexpected error. Please try again. {detail}
tool.errorInvalidPages: That page selection isn't valid. Use ranges like 1-3, 5.
tool.errorEncrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Unlock it first, then try again.
tool.errorCorrupt: This PDF couldn't be read — it may be damaged
tool.notFoundDesc: It's on the roadmap. Browse the toolbox meanwhile.
tool.summaryMinFiles: Add at least {count} files to continue
tool.splitWaitingDetect: Split inputs are still being detected — try again in a moment.
tool.splitNoBookmarks: This PDF has no bookmarks to split by.
tool.splitNoBlanks: No blank pages found — nothing to split at.
tool.splitNoParts: These split settings produce no files — adjust them and try again.

images.errorUnsupported: This image format can't be read here ({detail}). Convert it to JPG or PNG first.
images.errorDecode: Couldn't decode {detail} — the file may be damaged or unsupported on this browser.

tool.errorNoText: No selectable text found — this PDF is probably a scan. OCR is coming in a later phase.
tool.errorWatermarkMissing: Add the watermark text (or a logo) first.
tool.errorWatermarkChars: The embedded font can't carry this text — Latin letters, digits and Hindi (Devanagari) are supported.
tool.errorWatermarkLogo: The logo image could not be read. Try a PNG or JPG.
tool.errorWatermarkNoPages: No pages selected — check the pages option.
tool.errorPageNoPages: No pages selected — check the pages option.
tool.errorPageFont: The Hindi font could not be loaded. Retry, or turn Hindi digits off.
tool.errorSignNoPlacements: Place at least one signature on a page first.
tool.errorSignAssetMissing: A signature image could not be found — add it again and retry.
tool.errorSignAssetBroken: A signature image could not be read. Recreate it and retry.
tool.errorRedactNoMarks: Mark at least one redaction box first — search for text or draw one.
tool.errorRedactVerify: The redaction could not be verified. Nothing was downloaded — please try again.
tool.errorAlreadyEncrypted: This PDF is already password-protected — unlock it first.
tool.errorNotEncrypted: This PDF has no password — nothing to unlock.
tool.errorPwTooShort: The open password needs at least 6 characters.
tool.errorNoPages: No pages to scan — capture or add at least one photo.
tool.errorUnsupported: {detail} is not a photo this tool can read.
tool.errorEncode: The scan could not be rendered.

result.title: Your file is ready!
result.openPreviewLabel: Open file preview in a new tab
result.startOver: Start over with a new file
result.privacyLine: This file is only on your device — nothing was uploaded.

recent.title: Recent files
recent.note: Metadata and thumbnails only, on this device — file contents are never kept.
recent.reselectToast: File contents aren't stored (privacy) — please select the file again.

smartDrop.selectLabel: Drop a PDF here — or select a file
smartDrop.whatNext: What would you like to do?
smartDrop.officeNote: Office conversions use server processing and arrive in a later phase.

merge.emptyHint: Add files to set pages and order.
merge.rangeHint: Leave empty to include the whole file. Ranges like 1-3, 5.
merge.blankBetweenHint: Separates each file's pages with one empty page.
merge.flattenHint: Best effort: locks filled values into the page. Some complex forms may keep their fields.

split.emptyHint: Add a PDF to set up the split.
split.rangeHint: List ranges like 1-5, 8, 10-end — “end” means the last page.
split.rangePrompt: Enter ranges like 1-5, 8, 10-end to see the preview.
split.overlapWarning: Ranges overlap — those pages will appear in more than one file.
split.oneFilePerRangeHint: Off: all ranges are combined into one new PDF.
split.everyNHint: Cuts the document into equal parts of this many pages.
split.bookmarksList: each part starts where a bookmark points.
split.sizeHint: Pages are grouped so each part stays under this size.
split.visualHint: Tap the scissors between two pages to set a cut point there.
split.oddEvenHint: Creates two files: odd-numbered pages and even-numbered pages.
split.blanksNone: No blank pages found in this PDF.
split.blanksFound: {count} blank pages found — they act as separators and are removed.
split.blanksChipLabel: Blank pages that will be removed
split.noParts: Nothing to output with these settings.

grid.allDeleted: Every page is deleted — undo to bring them back.
grid.insertBlankLabel: Insert a blank page after the selection
grid.howSelect: Click to select · Shift+click for a range · Ctrl+click to add
grid.howDrag: Drag the handle on a page to reorder it.
grid.virtualHint: Large document — drag is off, use the move buttons instead.
grid.ctaAllRemoved: All pages are deleted — undo to continue
grid.summaryWaiting: Add a PDF to see its pages here.

igrid.hint: Drag cards to reorder · rotate or remove per image · add more below
igrid.emptyHint: All images removed — add at least one back before you run.
igrid.ctaNoImages: Add at least one image first

pdfimg.previewNote: Every selected page keeps this sharpness.

pdftxt.previewNote: Extraction runs on your device — this is exactly the text you'll get.
pdftxt.scanBody: This looks like a scan or image-only PDF. Extraction may come back empty until OCR ships in a later phase.

wm.textHint: Latin letters, digits, common symbols — and Hindi (Devanagari)
wm.textMissing: Type the watermark text first — the preview shows exactly what will be stamped.
wm.devaFontHint: Hindi text is stamped with the embedded Noto Sans Devanagari font — the built-in fonts can't carry it.
wm.tileHint: Repeats the mark in a diagonal pattern
wm.behindHint: Under the page's text and images
wm.markedAll: Runs on every page of the document.
wm.logoHint: PNG or JPG works best — others convert on your device
wm.logoMissing: Pick a logo image, or switch back to the Text tab.
wm.previewNote: Exactly what gets stamped — nothing leaves your device.
wm.previewFailed: This page could not be rendered for preview. The watermark may still apply — try running it.

pn.startHint: The first numbered page shows this value.
pn.hindiHint: Show ०१२३ instead of 0123 — the font is embedded in the PDF.
pn.hindiOn: Devanagari font gets embedded in your PDF (subset only).
pn.hindiRomanOff: Hindi digits apply to the four number formats, not to roman or letter numbering.
pn.fontForced: Hindi digits always render with the embedded Devanagari font.
pn.ctaNoPages: No pages selected — check the pages option.
pn.errorNoPages: No pages selected — check the pages option.
pn.errorFont: The Hindi font could not be loaded. Retry, or turn Hindi digits off.

hf.varsHint: Works in every field below, on every page.
hf.dateHint: Only used when {date} appears in a field.
hf.fontHint: Hindi text automatically switches to the embedded Devanagari font.
hf.ctaEmpty: Type something in at least one header or footer field first.

crop.previewNote: Drag the box or its handles — or type exact margins in the panel. Arrow keys nudge the box.
crop.afterNote: Exactly how the cropped page will look — nothing leaves your device.
crop.autoDone: Snapped to the content on page {page}
crop.autoEmpty: Couldn't find content edges on this page
crop.rectHint: Arrow keys move the box. Hold Shift to move by 10 points.
crop.marginsHint: Measured from each page's own edges. Auto-detect fills these in for you.
crop.pagesHint: Cropping applies to the pages you pick, with the same margins.
crop.ctaNoPages: No pages selected — check the pages option.
crop.ctaNoCrop: The crop box covers the whole page — drag it or set margins first.
crop.errorNoPages: No pages selected — check the pages option.

meta.fieldHint: Empty = removed from the file. Comma-separate keywords.
meta.stripXmpHint: A second copy of this info — some readers prefer it.
meta.ctaNoChanges: Nothing to change yet — edit a field first.

rmeta.untouched: Pages, text and images stay exactly as they are.
rmeta.emptyHint: No document information, custom fields or XMP data found — nothing to remove.
rmeta.summaryLine: {count} information fields {xmp} will be removed from the file.
rmeta.alsoXmpHint: Turn off to keep XMP data in the file.
rmeta.noteId: The internal file ID stays — PDF readers use it for integrity, it contains no personal data.
rmeta.noteExif: GPS data inside embedded photos (EXIF) is not touched — photos stay bit-for-bit identical. It is rare inside PDFs.
rmeta.ctaNothing: Nothing to remove — this PDF is already clean.

fill.previewNote: Each box marks a fillable field on this page — click a box to jump to its input.
fill.scanError: Could not read this PDF's form fields. The file may be corrupt or password-protected.
fill.noFieldsBody: This PDF has no AcroForm fields — its content is flat text, or it uses an XFA-only form (rare). You can still edit it with the other tools.
fill.noFieldsEditor: The visual editor (add text anywhere) arrives in a later phase.
fill.autofillDone: Filled {count} fields from your saved details
fill.autofillNoMatch: No fields matched your saved details
fill.profileHint: Saved only in this browser's local storage — never uploaded, never sent anywhere.
fill.ctaNoFields: No form fields to fill in this PDF
fill.ctaNoChanges: Fill at least one field first

sign.ctaNoSignatures: Place at least one signature on the page to continue
sign.previewHint: Pick a signature, then tap the page to place it
sign.armHint: Click on the page to place “{label}”
sign.previewFailed: This page could not be rendered for preview. Signing may still work — try running it.
sign.trayEmpty: No signatures yet. Draw, type or upload your first one.
sign.createdToast: “{label}” ready — click the page to place it
sign.quickHint: One tap creates the stamp, then you click it onto the page. Date and checkmark never touch your profile.
sign.quickNeedName: Add your name first (Fill out PDF profile) — or type it as a signature
sign.editEmptyBody: Select a placed signature on the page to change its pages, size, rotation and opacity.
sign.dialogDesc: Draw it, type it, or upload a photo — it stays on this device.
sign.drawHint: Sign below with your mouse, finger or stylus — just like on paper.
sign.uploadHint: Photo or scan of your signature on plain paper works best.
sign.uploadTooLarge: That image is too large (max 12 MB)
sign.uploadBadFile: That image could not be read. Try a PNG or JPG.

redact.ctaNoMarks: Mark something to redact first — search for text or draw a box
redact.previewHint: Drag on the page to draw a box; found text appears as red boxes
redact.previewFailed: This page could not be rendered for preview. Redaction may still work — try running it.
redact.findHint: Scans the document's text layer and marks every hit as a redaction box. Click a box to skip it.
redact.customPlaceholder: One word or phrase per line — e.g. a client name
redact.findNothingSelected: Pick at least one thing to search for
redact.findError: The text layer could not be read. You can still draw boxes manually.
redact.findNoneScan: This file has no selectable text — it looks like a scan. Draw boxes instead.
redact.howBody: Pages with boxes are flattened into images — their text layer, comments and form fields never enter the output file. After saving, the tool re-checks the file and fails loudly if any hidden text survived.

view.a11yViewer: PDF viewer — arrow keys move pages, Ctrl+F searches, G goes to a page
view.loadingBody: Pages stay on your device the whole time — nothing is uploaded.
view.passwordBody: Enter the password to open it for viewing. It is used only in this browser tab and never sent anywhere.
view.passwordWrong: That password did not unlock the file. Try again.
view.errorBody: The file may be corrupt or not a real PDF. Try the Repair tool after it ships, or use another copy of the file.
view.shareUnsupported: Sharing files is not supported in this browser — use Download instead.
view.how1: Open a PDF — it opens instantly on your device and never gets uploaded.
view.how2: Read it your way: zoom, spread, rotate, dark mode, search (Ctrl+F) and thumbnails.
view.how3: Print or download the original, or continue straight into Merge, Split, Rotate or Fill forms.

gp.surfaceSubtitle: Random, pronounceable or passphrase — made on your device
gp.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the value and copy manually
gp.needOneSet: At least one character set must stay on
gp.avoidAmbiguousHint: Removes 0 O 1 l I | and similar confusables
gp.pronHint: Built from syllables — easy to say out loud or dictate over a call, still much stronger than a human-made password.
gp.historyHint: Only this page's memory — closing the tab erases everything.
gp.privacyLine: Every character comes from Web Crypto on this device. Nothing is saved, logged, or sent anywhere.
gp.how1: Pick a mode: random, pronounceable, or a passphrase — then tune length, character sets or word language.
gp.how2: Read the honest strength meter: entropy in bits plus an offline-attack crack estimate, not marketing colors.
gp.how3: Copy with one tap and store it in your password manager — this page forgets it the moment you leave.

lock.formSubtitle: AES encryption happens on your device — nothing is sent anywhere
lock.pwRules: Minimum 6 characters — 12 or more is better. Needed to open the file.
lock.recoverWarn: If you forget the password it cannot be recovered — keep the original file or save the password somewhere safe.
lock.ownerPlaceholder: Full-control password (defaults to the open password)
lock.ownerHint: Opening with the owner password unlocks full rights — changing permissions later.
lock.permsHint: What someone opening with the open password may do. Enforced by well-behaved readers (Acrobat, Chrome, Preview).
lock.pwTooShort: Open password needs at least 6 characters
lock.privacyLine: The PDF, both passwords and permissions are applied in your browser — they never leave this device.

unlock.pwSubtitle: The file asks for a password when opening
unlock.pwHint: Type the password you use to open this PDF. Nothing is sent anywhere.
unlock.pwAccepted: Password looks right — ready to unlock
unlock.ownerSubtitle: This file opens freely — restrictions will be stripped
unlock.ownerBody: This PDF opens without a password but carries owner restrictions (printing, copying or editing disabled). Leave everything as is and run — the restrictions are removed while pages, forms and content stay identical.
unlock.unreadableBody: The PDF could not be opened. It may be damaged — try the Repair PDF tool first.
unlock.policyBody: Only unlock files you own, or have permission to modify. An unknown open password cannot be removed — by anyone.

scan.heroDesc: Point at any document — the page is detected, straightened and cleaned up into a multi-page PDF, all on this device.
scan.openCameraLabel: Open the camera to scan more pages
scan.cameraUnavailable: This browser has no camera access here — add photos from the gallery instead, they get the same treatment.
scan.hint: Tap a page to fix corners, change its filter or rotate it. Drag cards to reorder — the preview is exactly what the PDF will contain.
scan.ctaNoPages: Capture or add at least one photo first.
scan.capturedToast: {count, plural, =1 {1 page captured} other {# pages captured}}
scan.editDesc: Drag the corner handles onto the document corners — the right side shows the final page live.
scan.editHint: Drag the circles to the document corners. Keyboard: focus a handle, then arrow keys to nudge (hold Shift for bigger steps).
scan.previewAria: Live preview of the corrected page
scan.limitReached: Page limit reached (30) — finish this scan and start another.
scan.errDeniedHint: Allow camera access in your browser's site settings, then try again. The gallery picker below the camera always works too.
scan.errNotFound: No camera found on this device
scan.errUnsupported: This browser cannot open a camera here
scan.how1: Open the camera (or add photos) and capture each page — a live overlay tracks the document.
scan.how2: Adjust corners if needed and pick a filter: Original, Magic color, B&W or Grayscale — the preview is the final page.
scan.how3: Create the PDF on your device — download it, share it, or continue with Compress, Lock or Sign.
